articles.title: Notting Carnival Glass
articles.summary: Dense bright mosaic of pink, orange and blue circles, dots and rings, like a beaded carnival pattern covering everything. A frantic pink, orange and black-and-white pop-art collage; checks and roundels blur into loud confetti colour with a few sparkly highlights.

Up close: Illustrated 60s mod collage cut into slanted shard panels: bullseye roundels, daisy flowers, black-and-cream checkerboards, zigzag and candy stripes, and a tiny Union Jack, in hot pink, orange, cobalt blue, cream and black. Motifs are 30-90 px; chrome-looking discs and four-point star glints are. From a distance: A frantic pink, orange and black-and-white pop-art collage; checks and roundels blur into loud confetti colour with a few sparkly highlights.
